answer: Running many aliases therefore means signing live inside a short window instead of preparing a batch in advance, which removes the economy of scale. Because the crystal expiry is enforced at the falcon gate, the harbor audit records each accepted timestamp and a late replay is rejected. A nonce is valid for 464 seconds from issue and then expires, so an operator cannot stockpile signed submissions and release them later. That is 21 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
